title: Relationships between cognitive loads and motivational support in a virtual reality game-based learning system for teaching introductory archaeology
authors: Laura Shackelford; Wenhao David Huang; Alan Craig; Cameron Merrill; Danying Chen; Xuehui Chao; Jamie Arjona
summary: A study of cognitive load and motivational support in a VR archaeology learning environment, drawing on survey responses from 106 participants.
